summary: Full anchor coverage for eps 1-24 (plus a confirming ep 25 anchor). The adaptation is linear and well documented: shadowshouse.fandom episode infoboxes carry per-episode adaptation ranges, and every chapter page (1-82) carries the reverse episode field — the two views are fully consistent, and chapter-page volume fields match our stored volume boundaries exactly. Wikipedia's chapter list independently pins many episode boundaries via chapter-title/episode-title matches (ep7=ch29 'Incomplete Maps', ep18-end=ch61 'A Midnight Reunion', ep19=ch62 'Night Sky', ep21=ch67 'The Noble Robe's Identity', ep24-end=ch78, ep25-start=ch79, etc.). S1's last stretch diverges: ep 11 (mixed) adapts 46-47 plus a sliver of 48 and a condensed ch 51, then eps 12-13 are an anime-original Edward plotline (confirmed anime-only by mangashed/epicstream/fandom); S2 restarts at ch 48 and runs faithfully to ch 82 (continue at 83, corroborating the existing ep25 mu anchor). S2 also grafts vol-7 flashforward material early: ch 75 appears in eps 14 (post-credits) and 15 (flashbacks), ch 76 in ep 16 (flashbacks), before both are properly adapted in ep 24.
